newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin says Jan-May trade gap SKK 29.9 bln.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin says Jan-May trade gap SKK 29.9 bln.

text.p: The Slovak foreign trade deficit for the first five months of 1997 totalled 29.9 billion crowns, a Finance Ministry official, quoting preliminary figures, told Reuters on Monday.

"According to preliminary figures, our exports totalled 119.2 billion crowns while imports hit 149.1 bilion, which make the deficit for the January-May period total 29.9 billion crowns," ministry spokesman Jozef Mach said.
The trade deficit for January-May 1996 was 25.7 billion crowns.
